verses.english:
Oneness resonates infinitely
Eternal truth is Its name
The being who is doing all
Without fear
Without rivalry
Immortal in form
Never been born
Self-illuminating
By the Guru's grace.
~ Know ~
This was true before,
True in the beginning.
True right now,
Nanak, true forever more. [1]
verses.question: WHAT IS THE ULTIMATE TRUTH?

verses.english:
Bathing will not bring you purity,
nor from thousands of purifications.
Silence will not bring you silence,
nor by staying in deep meditation.
Fasting will not ease your hunger,
nor buying from all of the nations.
A million ideas won't go along with you,
no opinions or great education.
How to break the wall of falsehood,
how to make a life that is true?
You must walk the path of Divine Law,
Nanak, as it’s written for you. [1]
verses.question: WHAT IS THE WAY TO KNOW THIS TRUTH?

verses.english:
Divine Law makes creation,
Divine Law cannot be spoken.
Divine Law creates all life we see,
Divine Law bestows great majesty.
Divine Law brings lows and highs,
all joy and pain Divine Law writes.
One is blessed if Divine Law decides,
while others may wander far and wide.
Everything is within Divine Law,
beyond the Divine Law is none.
Nanak, if Divine Law is realised,
then the words of ego are gone. [2]
verses.question: WHAT IS DIVINE LAW?

verses.english:
Some will sing of all its power,
when empowered by the might.
Some will sing of all its gifts,
knowing that to be its sign.
Some will sing of all its virtues,
its greatness and its beauty.
Some will sing of all its wisdom,
its great and deep philosophy.
Some will sing that it creates,
then destroys things to dust.
Some will sing it takes life away,
then returns it back to us.
Some will sing that it's far from here,
some will sing that it's always near.
Whatever is said there'll always be more.
Many words were said by millions before.
The great Giver gives the takers feel worn.
Eating and eating through each age that's gone.
Divine Law commands and continues its way.
Nanak, it's worry-free and joyfully plays. [3]
verses.question: HOW CAN I RECOGNISE DIVINE LAW?

verses.english:
A master that's true and true is Its reign,
A language of love that none can contain.
We keep on asking for more and more,
so the great Giver gives without a pause.
What can we offer so Divine court can be seen?
What words do we say that when heard love begins?
In the hour of nectar contemplate the true name.
You'll be graced with honour and the door that liberates.
Nanak, then you'll know the Truth that permeates. [4]
verses.question: WHO IS THE DIVINE?

verses.english:
It can't be constructed nor can be created.
The One who exist in all yet separated.
Those who will serve It great honour they'll gain.
Nanak, let us sing of this treasure with praise.
Sing it and hear it with love in your mind.
Bring joy to your home and no pain you will find.
By facing the Guru you'll hear Divine sound,
by facing the Guru all wisdom is found,
by facing the Guru see Divine all around.
Make Guru your Shiva, Gorakh and Brahma,
let Guru be known as Paarvati mother.
Even if I knew no words could I say,
nothing I say could help to explain.
Guru, allow me to always know this.
Oneness provides to all those who live.
may I never forget the gifts that It gives. [5]
verses.question: HOW DO I REALISE THIS DIVINE?

verses.english:
I'd bathe in this pool if it pleases the One,
without Divine grace what cleanse can be done?
In all of creation that our eyes can see,
without Divine grace what can we receive?
This mind can have jewels, diamonds and pearls,
if the one true lesson of the Guru is heard.
Guru, allow me to always know this.
Oneness provides to all those who live,
may I never forget the gifts that It gives. [6]
verses.question: WHAT PRACTICES SHOULD I DO?

verses.english:
If life spanned four ages, then ten times beyond.
If known in nine regions, all followed you along.
If your name was praised and honoured worldwide.
Without Divine grace none would stay by your side.
A worm amongst worms you'd be shamed and blamed.
Nanak, if sinners would praise then virtues they'll gain.
None else has been known to give out such grace. [7]
verses.question: ISN'T THERE MORE TO ACHIEVE IN LIFE?

verses.english:
Listening are the sages, angels and guides.
Listening is the Earth, land and the skies.
Listening are the realms above and beneath.
Listening protects you where death cannot reach.
Nanak, the devotees are joyful in cheer.
Listening makes pain and sins disappear. [8]
Listening are Shiva, Brahma, Indra devs.
Listening makes the wicked begin to praise.
Listening joins the body to the unknown ways.
Listening makes Shastras, Simritis and Veds.
Nanak, the devotees are joyful in cheer.
Listening makes pain and sins disappear. [9]
Listening is a true, wise and peaceful state.
Listening is bathing in the holy sixty-eight.
Listening is reading then gaining esteem.
Listening is stillness and deep inner peace.
Nanak, the devotees are joyful in cheer.
Listening makes pain and sins disappear. [10]
Listening is an ocean of virtuous living.
Listening are leaders, preachers and kings.
Listening the blind can walk on their path.
Listening reveals the deep truths at last.
Nanak, the devotees are joyful in cheer.
Listening makes pain and sins disappear. [11]
verses.question: WHY SHOULD I LISTEN TO DIVINE LAW?

verses.english:
Acceptance is a state that none can explain.
Whoever will try they'll only feel shame.
No paper, no pen, no writer exists.
Acceptance is that which none can discuss.
This is the name to reach the Divine.
For those who accept within their own mind. [12]
Acceptance is awareness and intelligence in mind.
Acceptance brings knowledge of worlds intertwined.
Acceptance will never bring harm to your face.
Acceptance means death won't take you away.
This is the name to reach the Divine.
For those who accept within their own mind. [13]
Acceptance is a path with nothing in your way.
Acceptance is going with awakening grace.
Acceptance is a journey that won't lead astray.
Acceptance will bind you to live the right way.
This is the name to reach the Divine.
For those who accept within their own mind. [14]
Acceptance is opening liberation's door.
Acceptance brings support to family and all.
Acceptance is swimming as the Guru has taught.
Acceptance, O Nanak, you won't beg or fall.
This is the name to reach the Divine.
For those who accept within their own mind. [15]
verses.question: WHY SHOULD I ACCEPT DIVINE LAW?

verses.english:
The awakened are supreme, the awakened are leaders.
The awakened obtain all heavenly honour.
The awakened shine in the court of the King.
The awakened remain aware of the One.
Whoever will speak or tries to explain.
The Creator's way they cannot obtain.
The holy-bull is to be awakened inside,
from kindness it's born, with contentment it's tied.
Those who will know this they will be truthful.
Such is the load that's carried by the bull.
With so many lands and lands furthermore.
What is the power that carries them all?
So many lives with colours and names.
An all-flowing pen does write every page.
This wondrous story if anyone could write.
How wondrous a story might that one be like?
There's so much power and beauty on show.
And how many blessings, does anyone know?
All creation expanded from one Divine word.
Then millions of rivers had started to flow.
O Divine Nature, what should I say now?
Not even once am I worthy to bow.
What's pleasing to you to me is sublime.
You're always eternal, O formless Divine. [16]
Countless are chanting, countless are loving.
Countless who worship, countless restraining.
Countless of scriptures read again and again.
Countless of yogis are detached from within.
Countless devotees with wisdom and praise.
Countless who serve in countless of ways.
Countless of heroes who face many weapons.
Countless whose minds are in silent reflection.
O Divine Nature, what should I say now?
Not even once am I worthy to bow.
What's pleasing to you to me is sublime.
You're always eternal O formless Divine. [17]
Countless fools in darkness so deep.
Countless thieves who steal what they keep.
Countless rule with force and might.
Countless behead, murder and fight.
Countless sinners who sin as they go.
Countless are filthy, in filth do they roam.
Countless barbarics eat dirt as their bread.
Countless who gossip and burden their heads.
Nanak is humble and says this right now.
Not even once am I worthy to bow.
What's pleasing to you to me is sublime.
You're always eternal O, formless Divine. [18]
Countless names, countless places.
Distant, unreachable, countless spaces.
Calling it countless burdens the head.
From word is the name, from word is praise.
From word is wisdom and songs of grace.
From word is language, written and called.
And the words of fate are upon us all.
No fate is upon the Oneness who writes.
We only receive what Oneness decides.
Whatever It does, then that is Its name.
And without this name no place can remain.
O Divine Nature, what should I say now?
Not even once am I worthy to bow.
What's pleasing to you to me is sublime.
You're always eternal, O formless Divine. [19]
verses.question: WHAT IS AWAKENING?

verses.english:
With dirty hands, body and feet.
Water is used to make them neat.
If clothes are heavily stained and worn.
When soap is used the stains are gone.
When the mind is full and covered in sins.
The love of the name can cleanse it within.
No sinner is a saint by the words that are said.
But the actions you take are recorded instead.
You will have to eat whatever you sow.
Nanak, by Divine Law we come and we go. [20]
verses.question: WHY AM I NOT AWAKENED?

verses.english:
From pilgrimage, restriction, donations and care.
What little you'll gain won't even compare.
To listening, accepting, with love in the mind.
Journey within you and wash stains inside.
All virtues are Yours, I possess none.
Without having virtue no devotion is done.
Glory to the creation, the word and Divine.
The only true beauty ever pleasing the mind.
What moment of time, what night or what date?
In what season or month did creation get made?
Pundits don't know, nor do the Puraans.
Qazis don't know, nor does the Quran.
Which night or date no Yogis know,
the season or month no one can show.
That Creator from whom the world has grown,
the secrets are known by that One alone.
What to say, what to praise, what to know or explain.
Nanak, so many do speak and claim wisdom in vain.
Grand is the Master and grand is to praise
all that the Master has created and done.
Nanak, those who think they have all the answers,
will move on dishonoured and shunned. [21]
verses.question: WHAT ACTIONS SHOULD I TAKE?

verses.english:
Worlds beyond worlds and skies unclaimed.
They searched and grew tired, the Vedas explain.
Eighteen thousand worlds, holy books proclaim,
yet the ultimate truth remains the same.
What cannot be written, no-one can write,
what can be written, will fade from sight.
Nanak, all will say that It is so grand,
but the One alone knows and understands. [22]
Just praise and praise, without answers to delve.
Like rivers in the ocean who lose themselves.
Great kings and masters with wealth they collect.
Are no match for the insect who never forgets. [23]
verses.question: DOES ANYONE HAVE ALL THE ANSWERS?

verses.english:
There are...
Endless praises and endless who praise.
Endless creation with gifts that amaze.
Endless is seen and endless is heard.
Endless ideas of how Its mind works.
Endless ideas of how creation was made.
Endless ideas of Its infinite ways.
To find the end many have yearned.
But the end of This none can learn.
The end of This no one has known.
When more is said then more shown.
The grandest Master of the highest place.
Higher than that is the highest name.
If anyone else could become so grand.
The highest One they would understand.
But only It knows how grand It is.
Nanak, only the One can grant this gift. [24]
verses.question: HOW SHOULD I PRAISE THE DIVINE?

verses.english:
There's so much grace, no words can scribe.
The Grand One gives with no seed of desire.
So many warriors endlessly plead.
Too many to count, it's hard to perceive.
So many can argue, but falsehood deceives.
So many keep taking, ungrateful they remain.
So many are fools, consuming in vain.
So many are hurting, hungry and bruised.
Even still, O Divine, your gifts are infused.
Accepting Divine Law frees us from chains.
There's no other way that anyone can say.
If the arrogant ones explain other ways.
The wounds of defeat they'd feel on their face.
Only It knows and only It gives.
Yet only a few can speak about this.
Whoever is blessed to praise and sing.
Nanak, they’ll be a king amongst kings. [25]
verses.question: WHAT DIVINE GIFTS DO WE RECIEVE?

verses.english:
The priceless praise is a priceless trade.
With priceless traders and goods exchanged.
The priceless arrive and take the priceless away.
With priceless love, into the Priceless they fade.
In the priceless court there's a priceless way.
With priceless scales and priceless weights.
Where priceless mercy is the priceless way.
With priceless justice and priceless grace.
It is so priceless that no words can speak.
Yet speaking in praise is the connection you seek.
The Vedas speak and the Puraanas speak.
And those who read and narrate them speak.
The Brahmas speak and the Indras speak.
The many Krishnas and Gopees speak.
The Shivas speak and the sages speak.
The many Buddhas were created to speak.
The demons speak and the Devtas speak.
The angels, silent yogis and devotees speak.
So many are speaking or begin to speak.
So many have spoken then rise and leave.
If this many more were created to speak.
Yet no one still could define in speech.
As It pleases, only that is done.
Nanak, all is known by that eternal One.
Whoever will say these are useless words.
They will be known as the fool of the world. [26]
verses.question: WHY IS PRAISE SO IMPORTANT?

verses.english:
What is it like at that house and door,
where the Divine One sits protecting all?
Countless music plays and musicians abound,
with melodies, harmonies, and countless singers around.
Wind, water and fire, they all sing to You,
singing at Your door is the King of Justice too.
Chit and Gupt sing recording all our deeds,
and the King of Justice reflecting what he reads.
Shiva sings there and Brahma as well,
like Devi the Goddess, in beauty they dwell.
Indra is singing while sat on his throne,
with all other gods at Your door alone.
The sages are singing within meditation,
the wise ones sing in deep contemplation.
Self-restrained, charitable, and the contented ones,
brave and mighty warriors, all of them have sung.
Rishis and Pundits sing reading the Veds,
forever and ever throughout every age.
Angelic beauties sing enchanting the mind,
from realms high and low, and those intertwined.
The jewels You create join in the praise,
and each sixty-eight revered holy place.
All the bravest fighters and warriors do sing,
the four ways of creation who make everything.
All lands and regions and planets proclaim,
they sing unto You who creates and sustains.
You allow them to sing when pleased by their ways,
your devotees are drenched in the nectar of praise.
How many more are there, singing unto You,
I cannot know of this, what can poor Nanak do?
This and only This is the Master ever-great.
Present now and always, the Creator who creates.
Who made all the species, all colours and shapes,
and the illusion of Maya from Whom it emanates.
Creating and observing over everything It owns,
is the greatest-ever Master that anyone has known.
It does what It pleases, none can make demands.
This is the highest King, Nanak, live by Its command. [27]
verses.question: WHAT IS THAT DIVINE COURT LIKE?

verses.english:
A bowl of effort, with contentment earrings,
awareness the ash that he's all covered in.
A robe of death, a body self-controlled,
a cane of trust that he carries and holds.
A friend to all is the best monk you'll find,
who wins the world by winning his mind.
I bow, to This, I bow.
The first and pure, never ends or begun,
through every age the form of One. [28]
Eat wisdom as food, spread kindness around,
and within every heart hear Divine sounds.
Make the One your master, all others just learn,
for mystical powers have no taste or yearn.
Things come and go as fate decides,
we only receive what destiny writes.
I bow, to This, I bow.
The first and pure, never ends or begun,
through every age the form of One. [29]
verses.question: WHO IS A TRUE MONK?

verses.english:
From Oneness and Maya three servants arose.
One creates, one sustains, one justice bestows.
It commands and controls as It may please.
Yet remains concealed from all that It sees.
I bow, to This, I bow.
The first and pure, never ends or begun,
through every age the form of One. [30]
Within every realm Its treasure was stored.
Whatever was placed was once and for all.
The Creator creates and sees what It makes.
Nanak It is true and true are Its ways.
I bow, to This, I bow.
The first and pure, never ends or begun,
through every age the form of One. [31]
verses.question: HOW WAS THE WORLD CREATED?

verses.english:
May this tongue become a million,
and the million be twenty more.
They all could chant a million times
the name of the One and master of all.
There are steps upon this path,
climb them to unite as one.
Hear the heavenly words,
as worms pretend to have done.
Nanak, by grace the truth is found,
while the false make empty sounds. [32]
DO I HAVE THE POWER TO UNITE WITH THE ONE?
We have...
No power to silence, no power to speak.
No power to give, no power to plead.
No power to live, no power to die.
No power to rule the noise of the mind.
No power to know, to be aware or wise.
Nor to save the world, nor power to try.
It holds the power to see and do all.
Nanak, no one is big and no one is small. [33]
verses.question: HOW CAN I FIND THIS DIVINE?

verses.english:
Seasons, days, moons and nights.
Water, wind, fire and skies.
Earth was made as a sacred place,
for all to act and live the right way.
With various beings of colours and ways.
Too many to count they cannot be named.
However they act will all be reviewed.
By the all-true One whose court is true.
The awakened are there who shine supreme.
Blessed with grace for all to see.
There, the ripe or raw will be shown.
Nanak, going there can this be known. [34]
This is life's purpose on the sacred stage.
The stage of wisdom I will now narrate.
So many winds, waters and fires ablaze,
so many like Krishna and Shiva-Mahesh.
So many Brahmas who make and create,
the various forms of colours and shapes.
So many worlds to live out your days,
with holy mountains and Dhru-like saints.
So many Indra gods,
so many suns and moons,
so many land-regions,
so many countries too.
So many Siddhs and Buddhas,
so many mastered Yoga,
so many goddess Devis,
so many forms that vary.
So many silent-sages,
so many gods and demons,
so many are the jewels,
that fill the many oceans.
Many sources of creation,
many words of every nation,
so many rulers royal.
So many sages loyal,
O Nanak, there are so many,
the Endless never ends. [35]
In the wisdom stage wisdom shines bright.
There's music and joy and endless delight.
The stage of effort is to mould and shape.
To sculpt and refine until beauty is made.
This is a state that none can explain.
Whoever will try they'll only feel shame.
This shapes an aware and intelligent mind.
The mindset of angels and sages you'll find. [36]
In the stage of grace great power unfolds.
No other is there, none else to behold.
There heroes and warriors and brave are produced.
Within them Divine is completely infused.
Within them is praise all sewn-in and woven.
Their beauty beyond what words can be spoken.
They never will die nor can be deprived.
Whose mind has Divine remaining inside.
Devotees live there from far and wide.
Enjoying the bliss of the True One in mind.
The Formless resides in the eternal stage.
Creating and seeing with euphoric grace.
There are regions, lands, and planets aplenty.
Some try to explain with no end to infinity.
It is there where heavens upon heavens are formed.
As Divine Law commands, only that is performed.
Seeing, enjoying, reflecting on Its play.
Nanak, Divine essence is hard to explain. [37]
verses.question: WHAT ARE THE STEPS TO UNITE?

verses.english:
Like the goldsmith in his workshop,
have patience and self-restraint.
Make your mind like the worktop,
and hammer the wisdom of saints.
Have obedience as your furnace,
with self-discipline as your flames.
Let Divine nectar pour out,
in the vessel of love to contain.
Use the Divine word to mould and shape,
until eternal truth is the coin that’s made.
For those who are blessed, this is their way.
Nanak, Divine glance brings euphoric grace. [38]
verses.question: WHAT CAN I DO TO ACHIEVE ALL THIS?

verses.english:
~ Saloke ~
Air is a Guru, water is a father,
and Earth is like our greatest mother.
The child-minders are night and day,
within which the whole world plays.
All that is good and the bad everywhere,
the King of Justice will judge and declare.
By their own actions and by own their ways,
some will go nearer and some go astray.
Whoever was aware and remembered the name,
left having won the most difficult game.
Nanak, they are shining and their face radiates,
they became saved and many more they have saved. [1]
verses.question: WHAT IS LIFE'S ULTIMATE PURPOSE?
